programme.title: Melrose Place: Härifrån till moderskap
programme.desc: Alison, mot läkarens ordination, åker till D&D för att träffa en klient. Michael anlitar Megan som sin nya receptionist på Burns-Mancini.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Sista avfarten till Ohio
programme.desc: Kimberlys mamma kommer till stan för att övertyga henne att återvända hem till Cleveland efter att ha fått höra om hennes hälsotillstånd.

programme.title: Melrose Place: De döda fruars klubb
programme.desc: Jake tar med Alison till en privat tillflyktsort för att gifta sig. Jim försöker skaffa ett jobb på Shooters och fortsätter försöka vinna Samanthas respekt.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Déjà vu återigen
programme.desc: Michaels falska lillasyster, Jennifer Mancini, kommer till stan och flyttar in i strandhuset med honom och Megan.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Beth är över
programme.desc: Kyle överraskar Jennifer i strandhuset för att be om ursäkt för att ha avslutat deras affär, vilket leder till att Michael kastar ut henne.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Ultimatum som synden
programme.desc: När Jennifer tar ett jobb som servitris/exotisk dansös på en strippklubb, blir Megan orolig för att hon ska följa samma dåliga väg som hon.

programme.title: Melrose Place: På väg nånstans
programme.desc: Kyle räddar Jennifer på Megans begäran och låter henne bo i sin lägenhet i Melrose tills hon kan hitta ett bättre jobb.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Hemligheter och lögner, och fler lögner
programme.desc: Michaels och Taylors plan att sänka Peter inleds när Taylor drogar Peter och fejkar en attack.
programme.sub-title: Hemligheter och lögner, och fler lögner

programme.title: Melrose Place: Vem är rädd för Amanda Woodward?
programme.desc: När Samantha blir gripen försöker Billy förhandla för att få ut henne. Efter att Jake säljer Shooters gör Alison upp en plan för att få hans drömmar att slå in.
programme.sub-title: Vem är rädd för Amanda Woodward?

programme.title: Melrose Place: En helt ny dag
programme.desc: Craig klandrar Samantha för olyckan som dödade Sydney och hennes pappa. En ny kirurg ansluter sig till Michaels personal på Wilshire-sjukhuset.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Den trojanska storken
programme.desc: Cooper flyttar in i Matts tomma lägenhet i Melrose och börjar snoka i de inneboendes liv, inklusive Michaels historia med Kimberly.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Ingen tid för spermabanker
programme.desc: När Taylors så kallade graviditet stöter på problem, ber hon Michael impregnera henne och hjälpa henne bevisa att hon är gravid.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Läkaren är här...och insyltad
programme.desc: Samantha erkänner att hon råkade nämna att Billy och Amanda ska starta sin egen reklambyrå. Craig erkänner nederlag.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Samantha, var är du?
programme.desc: Sydneys pappa anländer i Los Angeles för att besöka Craig. Amanda Woodward Advertising öppnas med Amanda som vd och Eric som sponsor.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Ljuset i slutet av fallet
programme.desc: Peter får reda på Coopers koppling till den avlidna Kimberly Shaw: Han råkar vara läkaren som behandlade henne efter olyckan.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Hemligheter och fruar
programme.desc: Efter att Lexi beslagtar alla Coopers tillgångar, klandrar han felaktigt Michael för att berättat om hans dolda tillgångar.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Skott i mörkret
programme.desc: Peter förklarar sin kärlek för Lexi och hon flyttar in i hans hus. Jennifer hjälper Craig att sälja Mancini Glove.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Skalpellkvinnans attack
programme.desc: Efter att Cooper släpps ut ur fängelset, följer Megan efter honom och upptäcker att det var Kimberlys mamma som försökte döda Michael.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Min lilla koma-flicka
programme.desc: Cooper har en vaka medan Megan ligger i koma, men en svartsjuk Michael försöker stoppa besöken efter en déjà vu-upplevelse.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Tills döden skiljer oss åt
programme.desc: Walker försöker modigt rädda ett barn fast i en bil som dinglar från ett broräcke.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Regnbågskrigare
programme.desc: En begravning tar en vändning när offrets son bekänner att hans pappas död inte var en olycka.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Vägen till Black Bayou
programme.desc: Walker har beordrats att ta semester, men den visar sig vara långt ifrån stressfri.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Skottlinje
programme.desc: En korrupt polis försöker döda Alex efter att hon får insiderinformation om en ring av Dallas-poliser som stjäl beslagtagna droger från bevisrummen och säljer dem på gatan.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Hämnd
programme.desc: En belöning på 1 miljon dollar erbjuds personen som kan döda Cordell Walker

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Tigeröga
programme.desc: Texas Rangers försöker rädda en rik affärsmans dotter som har kidnappats av ett japanskt gäng.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Det stora bingobluffen
programme.desc: Walker försöker få ett huvudvittne att vittna så att han kan låta fälla en ökänd narkotikasmugglare.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Pengatåg
programme.desc: Rangers upptäcker att två stuntmän planerar en tågkupp.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Tuffa gator
programme.desc: När Rangers upptäcker att en grupp rika tonåringar misshandlar hemlösa och filmar bedriften, börjar Walker jobba under täckmantel för att ta fast gänget.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Cowboy
programme.desc: Alex blir kidnappad och Walker och Trivette måste hitta henne innan hon blir dödad.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Krigszon, del 1
programme.desc: Rangers förbryllas över en serie mångmiljonsrån utförda av män i clownmasker. Utredningen blir personlig när Walkers nära vän, Ranger Logan Reno, blir dödad.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Krigszon, del 2
programme.desc: Rangers förbryllas över en serie mångmiljonsrån utförda av män i clownmasker. Utredningen blir personlig när Walkers nära vän, Ranger Logan Reno, blir dödad.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Lita inte på nån
programme.desc: Bevispengar till ett värde av 5 miljoner dollar försvinner och Trivette anklagas för att ha stulit dem

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Vuxenfilmer
programme.desc: Walker måst bli kreativ för att ta en välrespekterad samhällsledare.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: På helig mark
programme.desc: Ett gäng unga cherokeser härjar fritt. De rånar museum och tar indianska artefakter.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Fall avslutat
programme.desc: Alex hittar en traumatiserad flicka som påstår att hennes pappa fångades av "himmelsfolket".

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Flashback
programme.desc: En guldgrävare dödas efter att ha grävt upp en skatt som hade varit förlorad sen 1860-talet. Walker guidas av Rangern Hays Coopers ande för att lära sig sanningen bakom försvinnandet av guldet.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Conqueror
programme.desc: Humankind conquered the world, in order to survive, and conquers his fellow humans with new ideas. We will see how we as a species have conquered the earth, how we still compete with viruses, and how quantum theory conquers China.

programme.title: Combat Forces: Reconnaissance
programme.desc: Knowing an enemies strengths and weaknesses is one of the key elements of success in combat. Reconnaissance units are specially trained soldiers and marines who go behind enemy lines to gather intelligence about the enemy force.

programme.title: Wild Germany: Coasts
programme.desc: The episode Coasts shows the magnificence of the German North Sea and Baltic Coastlines and presents unique animal footage filmed over more than five years.

programme.title: Wild Italy: From Sardinia to Abruzzo
programme.desc: In the episode “From Sardinia to Abruzzo”, the southern part of Italy is the focal point.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the Natural History Museum, London
programme.desc: From Darwin’s original specimens to a lost workshop that inspired James Bond, discover the secrets of Britain’s Natural History Museum.
programme.sub-title: Inside the Natural History Museum, London

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 207
programme.desc: A massive tornado rips apart a local high school while frightened students huddle inside. Then, intense wind and rain turn a high speed race into a demolition derby. Next, a raging river traps tourists and takes an entire town by storm.

programme.title: Art of the Heist: The Pharoes Head
programme.desc: Egyptian artifacts were stolen from the British Museum. Included: panels from a tomb in Saqqara, an ancient burial ground.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the National Museum of Anthropology, Mexico City
programme.desc: From ancient athletes who kick a severed head to a peasant dress that brings down an empire, discover the secrets inside the National Museum of Anthropology.
programme.sub-title: Inside the National Museum of Anthropology, Mexico City

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the Louvre
programme.desc: From murdered kings to stolen masterpieces, discover the secrets inside the Louvre.

programme.title: Ocean Stories: Dolphins and Whales
programme.desc: Dolphin expert Ute Margreff and wildlife film-maker Florian Graner share with us their passionate interest in these inhabitants of our oceans.

programme.title: Combat Forces: Full Spectrum Warfare
programme.desc: Whether at sea, in the air, or on land, modern warfare happens in all environments. In this special episode, we examine the different types of training which deal with multi-environment warfare, also known as full spectrum warfare.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the National Maritime Museum, London
programme.desc: From the musket shot that killed Admiral Nelson to an anti-piracy commando raid, discover the secrets inside the National Maritime Museum.
programme.sub-title: Inside the National Maritime Museum, London

programme.title: Art of the Heist: The Disappeared
programme.desc: Re-creating a crime in which artwork stolen from a Buenos Aires museum was traded for illegal arms.

programme.title: The Spying Game: Mission Behind the Iron Curtain
programme.desc: During the Cold War, tensions between East and West mount alarmingly.

programme.title: Art of the Heist: The Russian Conspiracy
programme.desc: The discovery of approximately 200 missing items totaling more than $5 million from the Hermitage Museum in Russia is featured.

programme.title: Waste Land
programme.desc: Dokumentärfilm om konstnären Vik Muniz, som återvänder till hemlandet Brasilien för att starta ett konstprojekt på Jardim Gramacho, världens största soptipp.

programme.title: 27: Gone Too Soon
programme.desc: The 27 Club är ett kulturellt tema som handlar om populära rockmusiker som dog vid 27 års ålder. Följ framväxten av begåvade musiker och deras destruktiva livsstilar, däribland en ofta missbrukande relation med alkohol och/eller droger.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues: Locusts
programme.desc: Swarms of locusts are still a very real plague today. They afflict drought areas, especially after a rare rainfall, leaving a trail of destruction behind.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Hospital on the Haunted Hill
programme.desc: Nick investigates a four-story hospital overlooking the city of Williamson, West Virginia that closed in 1988.

programme.title: A Haunting: Mother's Terror
programme.desc: When Jeanette's firefighter husband dies in the line of duty, she moves her daughters to a rustic hamlet in Long Island to start anew. Shortly after moving in, an evil entity lashes out at her daughter, Jeanette refuses to quit without a fight.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Morgan Fairchild, Lili Taylor, John Salley, Vincent Curatola
programme.desc: A young Morgan Fairchild is abused by a spirit when she moves into her new husband's family home.
programme.sub-title: Morgan Fairchild, Lili Taylor, John Salley, Vincent Curatola

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Chris McDonald
programme.desc: Christopher McDonald and Kim Russo travel to Christopher's adolescent home in Romulus, NY where he had a ghostly encounter with the other side.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Kendrick House
programme.desc: Nick visits The Kendrick House and sleeps on a table once used for surgeries to make contact with spirits.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Werewolves
programme.desc: The legend of the werewolf throughout history and in various cultures is explored. The Conspiracy Show travels to England and rural Wisconsin to investigate claims of actual werewolf sightings.

programme.title: A Haunting: Ghost Confessions
programme.desc: An unknown entity appears to find pleasure in terrifying 17-year-old Macy Sherman, her younger sister Kelsey and their mom Carrie. The family reaches out for help, praying that they can get rid of the spirit intent on staying in their home forever.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: The Others
programme.desc: The owners of the Willis House Inn in Michigan call Nick to see if their inn is safe to open.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories: Nene Leakes
programme.desc: TV personality and "The Real Housewives of Atlanta" star NeNe Leakes joins psychic medium Kim Russo to investigate paranormal events connected to a wedding she attended in Atlanta, GA.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Dream House and Ghost Month
programme.desc: A woman's recurring nightmare comes to life in her new house. A single mother fears for her son's life after moving into a new house.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Aaron Carter, Chris McDonald, Kaya Jones, David Proval
programme.desc: Aaron Carter's dying grandmother makes him promise her that he will perform a ritual after she dies to prove that spirits really do exist.
programme.sub-title: Aaron Carter, Chris McDonald, Kaya Jones, David Proval

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff
programme.desc: The Hinsdale House, with its chilling legacy rooted in the Dandy family's 1970s hauntings and an unsuccessful attempt at a structural exorcism, continues to captivate and terrify.

programme.title: A Haunting: Well To Hell
programme.desc: Mark Corvo finds a ceremonial altar in his attic. He reaches out to the Ghosts of New England Research Society for professional help. They believe tenants dabbling in the dark arts opened a portal to the other side and drew spirits to the location.

programme.title: A Haunting: Norman the Doll
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator, Stephen Lancaster, doesn’t believe in haunted objects until he captures proof the doll he recently acquired is haunted. Fearing he is in over his head, he attempts to get rid of it, but the doll has other plans.

programme.title: A Haunting: Cursed
programme.desc: Romie moves into a new home but begins to have nightmares and see shadowy spirits pacing.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Olde Park Hotel
programme.desc: Nick investigates the Olde Park Hotel in Ballinger, Texas.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Bill Bellamy, Dawn Wells, Jack Blades, Mary Lambert
programme.desc: Bill moves into a house that is inhabited by the ghost of a little girl who had a tragic accident there.
programme.sub-title: Bill Bellamy, Dawn Wells, Jack Blades, Mary Lambert

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Daryl Hannah, Maksim Chmerkovskiy, Shanna Moakler, Marilyn Manson
programme.desc: A young Daryl Hannah meets a mysterious woman who changes her life forever. Maksim Chmerkovskiy recovers from a devastating injury with the help of a woman who's not what she seems.
programme.sub-title: Daryl Hannah, Maksim Chmerkovskiy, Shanna Moakler, Marilyn Manson

programme.title: Paranormal State: Good vs. Evil
programme.desc: PRS visits a western Pennsylvania couple wracked by a torrent of paranormal activity. Religious objects have been destroyed, televisions, lights and fans mysteriously turn on.

programme.title: Secrets of the Paranormal World
programme.desc: Origins of the Devil and discussion with Matteo Borrini/Deborah Hyde.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 504
programme.desc: Louisas hippiemamma, Eleanor, kommer till byn och tar omedelbart över Martins kök för att göra en ört-tonic, som hon senare ger till barnet för att få honom att sluta gråta.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 505
programme.desc: PC Penhale blir chockad över att hans ex-fru, Maggie, plötsligt dyker upp och verkar ha glömt att de har separerat och vill nu veta varför han lämnade henne.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 506
programme.desc: Maggie får klartecken från doktorn och bestämmer sig för att återvända till Bude. PC Penhale tvingas vidta desperata metoder för att övertala henne att stanna i Portwenn.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 507
programme.desc: Bert Larges restaurang har ekonomiska problem. Han har inte ens råd till mat och dryck för ett välgörenhetsevent för att samla in pengar till Florence Dingles kattfristad.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 508
programme.desc: TIshell bestämmer sig för att hon inte kan dölja sin kärlek för Martin. Efter att hon druckit en drink, gjord på starka läkemedel, vidtar hon drastiska åtgärder.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 601
programme.desc: Portwenn är upptagen med förberedelserna för bröloppet mellan Doc och Louisa. Ruth har problem med att ta hand om James och så går strömmen.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 602
programme.desc: Louisa är tillbaka i skolan igen och deras nya dagmamma, Mel är sen till jobbet. När Mel till slut dyker upp blir Martin skeptisk till att lämna över deras barn till en som har svårt att passa tiden.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 603
programme.desc: En främling stannar upp när han ser Ruth, och spionerar sedan på henne när hon fikar med Caroline. Ruth är osäker på varför, men börjar känna sig obekväm.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 604
programme.desc: Louisa vill att Martin ska engagera sig mer med James, så hon låter honom ta James till deras lekgrupp där de måste para ihop sig med en mamma och hennes dotter för att sjunga sånger.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 605
programme.desc: Mrs Tishell återvänder till byn. Martin måste reda ut vad det är för fel på Lorna. Al och Morwenna råkar ut för ett onlinedejting-haveri och kärleken blomstrar mellan Bert och Jennifer.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 606
programme.desc: Hypokondrikern Malcom Rayner har problem med andningen och Martin frågar honom om han någonsin har jobbat nära asbest.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 607
programme.desc: Al får ett besök från två militärpoliser som letar efter James barnvakt, Mike Pruddy.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 608
programme.desc: Louisa åker till Spanien, Bert och Jennifer förlovningsfest avslutas med en smäll. Al hyllas som en hjälte för att ha räddat Carolines liv.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 701
programme.desc: Martin återvänder till Portwenn men utan Louisa som har åkt för att bo hos sin mamma i Spanien.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 702
programme.desc: Rachel kanske kan hjälpa Martin att förändra sig. Louisas återvändo gör att relationsfrågor mellan henne och Martin uppstår.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 703
programme.desc: Martin bestämmer sig för att flytta från kirurgin för att ge Louisa det utrymme hon behöver. Louisa blir lite fascinerad av att träffa Martin teapeut vilket snabbt avtar när Rachel föreslår parterapi.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 704
programme.desc: Louisa och Martin har sin första terapisession tillsammans och ingen av dem var förberedda på att det skulle få hemläxa.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 705

programme.title: Wildfire: Heartless
programme.desc: Kris increasingly becomes the object of Matt's affection; this renders his relationship with Gillian incompatible.

programme.title: Wildfire: Diplomacy
programme.desc: Kris and Matt's rekindled relationship comes as a shock to Junior, who is distracted by consoling Dani in her time of mourning.

programme.title: Wildfire: You Can't Count On Me
programme.desc: Kris' endeavors to get accustomed to her new relationship with Matt and deal with Pablo's departure are interrupted by a surprise visit from her half brother (Ignacio Serricchio).

programme.title: Wildfire: Picking Sides
programme.desc: Kris tries to repair the rift between Matt and Junior, but the tension is exacerbated by the approach of the important Bristol Stakes and the return of Gillian, who proceeds to resume her bonding with Junior.

programme.title: Wildfire: So Long, Pardner
programme.desc: In the third-season finale, Kris and Matt weigh a generous offer from Sheik Omar that would go a long way toward easing Raintree's financial woes---but that also may be against the law.

programme.title: Wildfire: The More Things Change: Part 1
programme.desc: The fourth season begins six months after Kris was forced out of Raintree, which has undergone significant operational changes that leave Matt pining for the past.

programme.title: Wildfire: The More Things Change: Part 2
programme.desc: After Kris unexpectedly returns for a glimpse of Wildfire's next race, she gains an unlikely ally and a place to stay.

programme.title: Wildfire: Calm
programme.desc: Jean and Pablo are adamant that Kris leave town instead of sticking around and helping to care for Wildfire.

programme.title: Wildfire: Flames
programme.desc: Kris and Junior help Matt with his improbable plan to get Raintree back in the horse-racing business, which involves finding Wildfire's offspring, Flame.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Friend
programme.desc: Junior's preoccupation with his and Calvin's business proposition takes time away from his wedding plans, but Laura suspects his loss of focus may have something to do with Kris.

programme.title: Wildfire: Friendship/Passion
programme.desc: The pressure is on Junior to decide whether or SVt to go through with his wedding to Laura after he and Kris share a moment of passion.

programme.title: Wildfire: Commitment Issues
programme.desc: When it appears that Flame is ready for his first race, Kris decides to fight to get her jockey's license reinstated.

programme.title: Wildfire: Life's Too Short
programme.desc: Kris hopes that Flame's success in the DuPont Stakes might help Jean change her mind about Raintree's future, but Kris isn't so sure about what part---if any---she'll play in it.

programme.title: Wildfire: Vows
programme.desc: Kris and Junior hastily decide to get married, but they're forced to postpone their plans when Jean is injured by one of the horses rescued by Matt.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Comeback
programme.desc: With Jean still out of commission, Kris and Matt do their best to run the dude ranch at Raintree while also preparing for the next race, which features Dani's new horse in the field

programme.title: Wildfire: Being Mrs. Junior
programme.desc: Universal disapproval of Kris and Junior's wedding plans has everyone on edge, and even Kris wonders if she has what it takes to be part of the Davis family.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Ties That Bind: Part 1
programme.desc: Kris and Junior consider a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to relocate to Alaska for a year to work on a geothermal project in the series' penultimate episode.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Ties That Bind: Part 2

programme.title: On the Case: Murder in Room 205
programme.desc: A young woman's journey to a new life comes to a savage end in a roadside motel.

programme.title: On the Case: Cry on My Shoulder
programme.desc: When a young woman disappears, police zero in on her violent ex-boyfriend. But the secret to solving the case is buried in a cold case file.

programme.title: On the Case: Last Rites
programme.desc: When a nun is found strangled and stabbed to death on the day before Easter, investigators are forced to look behind church walls in search of a killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Predator
programme.desc: A sexual predator viciously murders a 16 year old girl. Can investigators catch him before he kills again?

programme.title: On the Case: Tracks of a Killer
programme.desc: Police retrace a young woman's final movements with hope that it will lead them straight to her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Mystery In The Desert
programme.desc: When an innocent couple is murdered execution style in the Arizona desert it marks the beginning of a 50 year search for the truth. Who really killed them and why? After decades of investigation the controversial case remains shrouded in mystery

programme.title: On the Case: Fatal Footage
programme.desc: An innocent mother of two is mysteriously shot in downtown Philadelphia. Surveillance cameras record every detail but can't unmask the killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Stabbed in the Heart
programme.desc: A beloved mother of four is stabbed to death in her bathroom. A mysterious v shaped wound on her forehead finally leads police to her killer decades later.

programme.title: On the Case: Shattered Hope
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Shelley Sikes vanishes one night after her shift, and then her abandoned, blood-streaked car is discovered on a dark roadway.

programme.title: On the Case: The Green Dragon
programme.desc: A four year old boy's terrifying discovery sends police on the hunt for a vicious killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Haunting Memories
programme.desc: Twenty-year-old college student Kim Montelaro goes missing from a mall parking lot, then her lifeless body is found in a ravine five miles from the mall; investigators piece together the timeline of Montelaro's last moments alive and crack the case.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder Ordained?
programme.desc: When a young minister's wife is found dead, it appears to be a tragic accident. But then, another member of the congregation is murdered. Police begin to wonder if its just a coincidence or a calculated plot.

programme.title: On the Case: The Answer Was No
programme.desc: Police try to retrace a young mother's last known movements in an attempt to solve her mysterious disappearance.

programme.title: On the Case: A Betrayal Concealed
programme.desc: A 17-year-old's shocking murder shatters the peace in a small town and destroys her family.

programme.title: On the Case: A Killer in Disguise
programme.desc: Police race to track down the unlikely killer responsible for three terrifying murders.

programme.title: On the Case: Predator on the Loose
programme.desc: A deadly predator haunts the city of Stockton, California and becomes more and more violent.

programme.title: On the Case: A Slip of Fate
programme.desc: A woman is found clinging to the guardrail of a steep embankment. She tells police a harrowing story; two men had attacked her and her husband at gunpoint and now he is missing. Was it a robbery gone wrong or part of a far more sinister plot?

programme.title: On the Case: Desperate Cry
programme.desc: A mother's desperate cry for help alerts neighbors and leads to a terrifying discovery.

programme.title: On the Case: Unanswered Questions
programme.desc: Patti Berry disappears on the way to pick up her child at the babysitter's, then her body is found in a secluded wooded area not far from her abandoned blood-soaked car.

programme.title: On the Case: Screams for Justice
programme.desc: The eyewitness accounts of neighbors may help or hinder investigators as they seek to solve the murder of a young woman.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Duane lands a huge contract for the Electra and puts enormous pressure on mechanic Adam to prep the plane without the help of his mentor Chuck.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Top of the World
programme.desc: The Electra flies to Alert, the northernmost settlement on Earth, forcing Adam and new senior manager Duane to work things out.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Last Days
programme.desc: Sparks fly when Joe discovers Gord has taken a job with a rival airline after completing expensive training on one of the Buffalo planes

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Push Comes to Shove
programme.desc: Trying to make his mark at Buffalo, Duane lands two more Electra contracts. But his over- zealous efforts result in a clash with the crew and with Joe, and a down-to-the-wire midnight departure to meet a deadline.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The Doghouse
programme.desc: Duane's decision to leave the Electra crew unsupervised while he spends time at home jeopardizes the completion of a major contract, and could cost him his job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Strip
programme.desc: Mechanic Jimmy is sent to a northern mining camp to create an ice landing strip on a remote lake where AJ will have to land a DC-3 and the much bigger C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Expect the Unexpected
programme.desc: Engine troubles on the C-46 during the valley run force Devan to shut down an engine. High winds wreak havoc for Devan and his crew on another C-46 mission to help clean up an oil spill in the Northwest Territories.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Coming Home
programme.desc: Rookie waterbomber pilot Scott gets his first taste of action when Buffalo responds to an emergency callout to fight fires in Alberta. Mikey and Rod think they hit the jackpot when they buy a million dollar firefighting plane on eBay at a bargain price.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dark Skies
programme.desc: When Yellowknife and the northern aviation community are rocked by three crashes in the space of a month, Joe places an extra emphasis on safety, which is why he only trusts himself to perform a dangerous-looking DC-3 stunt.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Shut Down
programme.desc: Joe receives a negative visit from Transport Canada when inspectors threaten to shut down the airline. Ray and the Electra crew fly to Sachs Harbour to pick up a unique load - the hides, wool, and meat of 250 musk oxen.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Tale of Two Pilots
programme.desc: Weighed down by the responsibility of training a new rampie, and struggling to get out of Joe's doghouse, DC-3 co-pilot Tyler gets a once in a lifetime opportunity to stunt fly in his Cessna 150 for a visiting film crew.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Jam
programme.desc: After taking command of an intense airlift, and dealing with the ugliest Electra load he's ever seen, Scott takes a scary fall on the icy tarmac.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Very Buffalo Christmas
programme.desc: A week before Christmas, Buffalo agrees to lend a hand to an RCMP initiative to fly toys to isolated communities in the north. But a series of problems with the Electra leave the company in a jam.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Crash Landing
programme.desc: Just months from retiring, Electra captain Ray Weber leads his crew on a multi-trip mission that requires landing on a rough ice strip on a remote lake.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: For Sale By Owner
programme.desc: When South Korean buyers come to Buffalo to look at a water bomber, the pressure is on mechanic Cory to get the plane ready. But a landing gear emergency puts him and chief pilot Justin in serious danger.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Desperate Half-Hour
programme.desc: Bud's prison pen pal arrives to rob the Bundys.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: How To Marry A Moron
programme.desc: Al objects to Kelly marrying an armed robber, until he discovers that he's the heir to a family fortune.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Chicago Shoe Exchange
programme.desc: Al and Griff trade the shoe store's inventory for a massage chair.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Pilot
programme.desc: A down-on-his-luck shoe salesman, Al Bundy, who’s unhappily married with two children, is forced to choose between going to a basketball game or joining his lazy wife, Peg, in meeting their new neighbors.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Thinergy
programme.desc: Marcy introduces Peg to a new energetic diet to improve her marriage. Al, meanwhile, wants to part of it but learns if he tries the diet, he can persuade Peg to quit. He must then swallow his pride and admit to Peggy he loves her no matter what.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Sixteen Years & What Do You Get
programme.desc: It's the Bundy’s 16th wedding anniversary. Al plans to buy Peggy a very fancy watch, but unfortunately, his credit card gets declined. Dare he show up at the party without a present?
programme.sub-title: Sixteen Years & What Do You Get

programme.title: Våra värsta år: But I Didn't Shoot the Deputy
programme.desc: There has been a rash of burglaries in the area, and the Rhodes' house is robbed and Al's car stereo is ripped off. Steve and Marcy buy a guard dog that won't stop barking, and Al purchases a fire arm. Ultimately, the two methods of home defense clash.
programme.sub-title: But I Didn't Shoot the Deputy

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Have You Driven a Ford Lately
programme.desc: Al and Steve buy a beat up Ford Mustang off of one of Kelly's boyfriends. Soon they form a tight friendship while fixing it up like new. The only problem is they are neglecting their wives.
programme.sub-title: Have You Driven a Ford Lately

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Whose Room Is It Anyway
programme.desc: Steve and Marcy plan to add a new room onto their house using their tax refund money. Al convinces Steve to make it into a billiards room while Peggy convinces Marcy to make it into an exercise room.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Al Loses His Cherry
programme.desc: Al gets a first-hand look at swinging bachelor life when he takes refuge at Luke's apartment after an argument with Peggy over visiting her relatives for the weekend.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Peggy Sue Got Work
programme.desc: To get the money to purchase a new VCR that Al won't buy her, Peggy takes a job in a department store selling clocks.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Married Without Children
programme.desc: When Al and Peg decide to go on vacation, Steve and Marcy volunteer to take care of their kids, Bud and Kelly. But, their enthusiasm changes when the kids throw a huge party at the Rhoades' house.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Poker Game
programme.desc: Al invites Steve to play poker with his friends, but ends up losing his paycheck to Al. Avoiding telling the truth to Marcy fails as Al plans to use his winnings to buy a fishing rod. Ultimately, Marcy enlists the help of Peggy to stop him.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Where's the Boss
programme.desc: When the owner of the shoe store is in a near-fatal plane crash, Al decides that it is time to get some recognition from his boss or quit his job. After quitting, Al returns to the shoe store, but not without a surprise.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Nightmare on Al's Street
programme.desc: Marcy freaks out when she begins having erotic dreams about Al after a heated argument about men vs women, and wonders whether she is actually sexually attracted to Al. Haunted by her dreams, Marcy ultimately comes to a conclusion and confronts Al.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Johnny B. Gone
programme.desc: Al and Peggy delay going to a closing of their favorite hamburger joint, Johnny Be Good's, when Bud and Kelly need them to solve their own problems. Meanwhile, Steve and Marcy prepare a party for their bosses at home.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Buck Can Do It
programme.desc: Al is reluctant to have Buck neutered despite being threatened with lawsuits from numerous neighbors regarding Buck's "nocturnal carnal activities.”

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Poppy's By The Tree - Pt 1
programme.desc: The Bundys take a vacation to near-beautiful Dumpwater, Florida and stay in a cut-rate motel where an ax murderer that hates tourists shows up every five years since 1967.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Poppy's By The Tree - Pt 2
programme.desc: After a hair-raising encounter with the maniac, Al decides to get the family out of town. But, they are trapped at the motel by a storm and the locals are unwilling to help them.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: If I Were a Rich Man
programme.desc: Steve takes Al to the vault at the bank where Steve works for a secret after-hours card game. The next day, one million dollars is reported missing.
programme.sub-title: If I Were a Rich Man

programme.title: Våra värsta år: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Al gets heated up over the large phone bill and refuses to pay it. This results in the disconnection of the Bundy phone line and making him the target of hostility from Peggy, the kids and the Rhodes who now take the Bundys phone calls on their phone.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 1
programme.desc: While Al and Steve are occupied by a female employee who fixes the Bundy's refrigerator, Peggy invites Marcy to a strip club with the girls.
programme.sub-title: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 1

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 2
programme.desc: Marcy loses her composure and wedding ring when it slips into a dancer's briefs while slipping him a tip. Desperate to keep the news from Steve, Marcy sets out to distract him every chance she gets.
programme.sub-title: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 2

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Born to Walk
programme.desc: Al flunks his written drivers test the same day that Kelly passes hers, leading him confined to the house and unable to get to the racetrack to bet on an important horse race.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Alley of the Dolls
programme.desc: Victory seems assured when Steve agrees to join the Bundys for a family team bowling match against Peggy's arch rival from high school, Mimi, and her obnoxious family.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Razor's Edge
programme.desc: Steve returns home having grown a beard from a week-long rafting trip. He and Marcy get into a huge argument over his reluctance to shave it off, leading him to move in with the Bundys.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: How do You Spell Revenge?
programme.desc: Al, Peggy and Bud are part of a shopping mall softball team playing other mall teams. After losing a few too many games, Al demands that Peggy improve her softball skills or she is off his team.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Earth Angel
programme.desc: There's a new light in the neighborhood when Bud brings home an attractive, free spirited, 21-year-old artist named Tiffany on her way to art school in New York. Everyone likes her, except Marcy, who thinks Tiffany steals the attentions of Steve.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: You Better Watch Out
programme.desc: The Bundys' Christmas is rudely interrupted when a parachuting mall Santa crash-lands into their backyard, attracting the neighborhood kids.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Guys and Dolls
programme.desc: When starting a baseball card collection, Al and Steve sell Marcy's old Barbie doll. They must get it back, but learn that the shop they sold it to was robbed.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Build a Better Mousetrap
programme.desc: Al's attempts to get rid of a rodent in the Bundy house end badly.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Master the Possibilities
programme.desc: Al, under the impression that you don't have to pay for anything you didn't order, takes Peggy and Bud on a wild spending spree when the mailman accidentally leaves a new credit card addressed to Buck the dog.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Blonde and Blonder

programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.desc: Det är 2200-talet och en utomjordisk makt tömmer haven. För att rädda mänskligheten måste Kirk och hans besättning resa till 1986 där de hittar en värld av punk, pizza och kontantbetalning på bussarna, det mest främmande de någonsin stött på.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Enterprises besättning ger sig ut på den ultimata resan på jakt efter Gud och kosmos mysterier, som båda tros finnas på den legendariska planeten Sha Ka Ree.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Federationen och klingonerna är på randen till ett fredsmöte när ett klingonskepp nästan förstörs av en attack från vad som verkar vara Enterprise. Båda världarna stålsätter sig inför vad som kan bli deras dödligaste möte.

programme.title: Cheers: Fairy Tales Can Come True
programme.desc: Frasier ber Sam att eskortera Diane till ett evenemang när han är bortrest.

programme.title: Cheers: Sam Turns the Other Cheek
programme.desc: Sam får uppleva konsekvenserna av att bli involverad med en gift kvinna.

programme.title: Cheers: Coach in Love: Part 1
programme.desc: Coach friar kort efter att ha upplevt kärlek vid första ögonkastet.

programme.title: Cheers: Coach in Love: Part 2
programme.desc: Sam och Diane försöker övertyga Coach att inte gifta sig.

programme.title: Cheers: Diane Meets Mom
programme.desc: Frasiers mamma hotar Diane till livet när de träffas för första gången.

programme.title: Cheers: An American Family
programme.desc: Carlas exmake återvänder med sin nya brud och kräver vårdnaden av deras äldsta son. Den normalt eldiga Carla chockar alla i baren när hon går med på hans begäran.

programme.title: Cheers: Diane's Allergy
programme.desc: Efter att ha flyttat in hos Frasier utvecklar Diane en kronisk allergi, och hon tror att den har orsakats av hans älskade hund Pavlov.

programme.title: Cheers: Peterson Crusoe
programme.desc: Norm bestämmer sig för att leva livet fullt ut när han får tillbaka provresultaten från sina hälsotester.

programme.title: Cheers: A Ditch in Time
programme.desc: Sam har en oskyldig flirt med den attraktiva barbesökaren Amanda, men han hamnar i trubbel när han inte förstått att hon är medlem i Dianes terapigrupp.

programme.title: Cheers: Whodunit?
programme.desc: Frasiers vördade mentor blir helt betagen av Carla.

programme.title: Cheers: The Heart Is a Lonely Snipehunter
programme.desc: Killarna utsätter Frasier för ett grymt skämt medan de är ute på en fisketur.
programme.sub-title: The Heart Is a Lonely Snipehunter

programme.title: Cheers: King of the Hill
programme.desc: Sam går med på att spela en välgörenhetsmatch i softball mot ett lag av Playboy-pinuppor.

programme.title: Cheers: Teacher's Pet
programme.desc: Sam återvänder till skolan för att få sitt gymnasiediplom.

programme.title: Cheers: The Mail Goes to Jail
programme.desc: Norm äventyrar Cliffs jobb när han tar över hans postutdelningsrutt för en dag.

programme.title: Cheers: Bar Bet
programme.desc: Ett gammalt vad tvingar Sam att välja mellan att gifta sig pch att förlora Cheers.

programme.title: Cheers: Behind Every Great Man
programme.desc: En vass reporter besöker Cheers och tröttnar på Sams arrogans.

programme.title: Cheers: If Ever I Would Leave You
programme.desc: Nick återvänder för att vinna tillbaka Carlas kärlek efter att hans fru har lämnat honom.
programme.sub-title: If Ever I Would Leave You

programme.title: Cheers: The Executive's Executioner
programme.desc: Norm tvingas ta en befordran som innebär att han måste avskeda sina medarbetare.

programme.title: Cheers: Cheerio Cheers
programme.desc: Diane väljer efter mycket tvekan att lämna Cheers och resa till Europa med Frasier, som har erbjudits en tillfällig tjänst vid Bolognas universitet.

programme.title: Cheers: The Bartender's Tale
programme.desc: Carla anställer en engelsk kvinna för att fylla Dianes plats medan hon är i Europa.

programme.title: Cheers: The Belles of St. Clete's
programme.desc: Carla hämnas på sin gamla rektor som hon verkligen hatade.

programme.title: Cheers: Rescue Me
programme.desc: I denna rysare till säsongsfinal friar Frasier till Diane medan de är i Europa, och han vill att de ska gifta sig redan nästa dag.

programme.title: Cheers: Birth, Death, Love and Rice
programme.desc: Frasier återvänder till Cheers med nyheter om att Diane har börjat jobba på ett kloster.

programme.title: Cheers: Woody Goes Belly Up
programme.desc: Sam och Diane överraskar Woody med ett besök från hans flickvän som bor i deras hemstad.

programme.title: Cheers: Someday My Prince Will Come
programme.desc: Diane hittar en kappa och tror att den mystiske ägaren är hennes drömmars man.

programme.title: Cheers: The Groom Wore Clearasil
programme.desc: Carlas 16-åring vill gifta sig med sin high school-älskling.

programme.title: Cheers: Diane's Nightmare
programme.desc: Diane är övertygad om att den galne skådespelaren från hennes förflutna är ute efter henne.

programme.title: Cheers: I'll Gladly Pay You Tuesday
programme.desc: Sam försöker dölja sanningen när han tappar bort Dianes ovärderliga bok.

programme.title: Cheers: 2 Good To Be 4 Reel
programme.desc: Killarna på Cheers försöker få Carla på bättre humör när hon lägger ut en kontaktannons.

programme.title: Cheers: Love Thy Neighbor
programme.desc: Norm anlitar en privatdetektiv för att ta reda på om Vera har en affär.

programme.title: Cheers: From Beer To Eternity
programme.desc: Cheers-gänget utmanar en rivaliserande bar i en bowlingturnering.

programme.title: Cheers: The Bar Stoolie
programme.desc: Cliff får reda på att hans främmande far lever ett hemligt liv.

programme.title: Cheers: Don Juan Is Hell
programme.desc: Sam används som ämne i Dianes uppsats.

programme.title: Cheers: Fools And Their Money
programme.desc: När Woody blir beroende av fotbollsbetting så kliver Sam in för att få honom att inse sina misstag.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Deadly Trap in the Forest - Christophe Belle
programme.desc: On March 19th 1998, Akira Ojima, a 57 years old japanese architect, is found dead in the fridge of a villa in Nanterre.
programme.sub-title: Deadly Trap in the Forest - Christophe Belle

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
programme.desc: On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows?
programme.sub-title: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mathilde Croguenne Case
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending \"Teknival\" in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer among the 43,000 participants of this festival

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Laurence Dromard Case
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want her dead.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)
programme.desc: On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. She made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept.
programme.sub-title: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.
programme.sub-title: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)
programme.desc: On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had found her unconscious in the bathroom with a mysterious plastic bag next to her
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)
programme.desc: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a road accident while on honeymoon. His wife Aurore is unharmed by the accident.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Priscillia Ciatti Case
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and –an extra sordid detail – a devil mask is found next to her body.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Drost Notthoff Case
programme.desc: On September 11th 2011, in Èze, near Monaco, the owner of a luxury villa discovers the lifeless hanging body of his tenant, a rich German businessman.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Little Martyrship of A10: The Inass Touloub Affair
programme.desc: On August 11, 1987, the Orléans police discover the bruised corpse of a 4-year-old child behind a guardrail on the A10 motorway.
programme.sub-title: The Little Martyrship of A10: The Inass Touloub Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Shadow of A Serial Killer: The Sophie Le Tan Case
programme.desc: On September 7, 2018, in Strasbourg, Sophie Le Tan is about to celebrate her 20th birthday with her family.
programme.sub-title: The Shadow of A Serial Killer: The Sophie Le Tan Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Audrey Jouannet Case
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot At Point-Blank: The Aurelie Barbot Affair
programme.desc: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.
programme.sub-title: Shot At Point-Blank: The Aurelie Barbot Affair

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 903
programme.desc: Nanna har genomgått flera bröstoperationer och korrigeringar, men har nu kvar missformade, hårda bröst. Heidi kan inte stå ut med att se sig själv eller andra nakna på grund av operationerna.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 401
programme.desc: Vi möter Christina, en perfektionist som efter två kejsarsnitt har ett fult ärr och en bula på magen, som hon experimenterar med att dölja genom att svepa in magen i plastfilm.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 805
programme.desc: Som tonåring har Linette en sned septum i näsan som orsakar andningsproblem. När hon är 21 år erbjuds hon en näsoperation för att rätta till problemet, men får en krokig näsa.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 106
programme.desc: Vi möter fyra personer som har genomgått plastikkirurgi med förödande konsekvenser, däribland Lone, som lever i rädsla för att hennes implantat är cancerframkallande.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 307
programme.desc: Vi möter Connie, som ville ha naturliga bröst men blev rekommenderad av sin kirurg att välja de största implantaten.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 201
programme.desc: Idag möter vi Dorthe, som har så svårt att släppa taget om sitt gamla jag att hon har kvar sina infekterade implantat. Michela skäms över sina bröst och gömmer sig i stora luvtröjor.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 204
programme.desc: Vi möter Melissa som ångrar sin operation djupt, och Helle, som täcker sig efter sin operation på armarna. Samtidigt är Lenes högsta önskan att kunna göra något bra för sig själv.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 902
programme.desc: Efter en bröstoperation har Samantha tunga, smärtsamma bröst och ett förhållande som är i gungning. Allan har senare uttryckt sin oenighet med Samanthas förklaring till varför förhållandet tog slut.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 702
programme.desc: Misslyckad plastikkirurgi har lämnat tre patienter med ärr på både kropp och själ. Nu är två av landets skickligaste plastikkirurger redo att erbjuda sin hjälp igen.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 304
programme.desc: Misslyckade plastikoperationer ger kvinnor ärr på både kropp och själ. Vi möter Sasja som har gjort en bröstförminskning, men nu känner att hon måste dölja sina bröst som är olika stora.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 305
programme.desc: Vi möter Jonna, som efter sin plastikoperation tycker att hennes mage ser ut som en bombkrater. Hon kämpar samtidigt med en otäck lukt från sin navel.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 206
programme.desc: Möt Louise, som brände familjens pengar på en bröstoperation, vilket slutade med en dramatisk upplevelse. Jeanette är dagligen rädd att hennes implantat ska förgifta henne.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 310
programme.desc: Vi möter kroppsbyggare Ulla, som ville ha bröst som skulle göra att hon såg mer feminin ut, men har nu fått så stora implantat att hon har svårt att träna.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 407
programme.desc: Vi träffar Maria, som efter en bröstoperation drabbades av stora abscesser och hål ända fram till implantatet.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 311
programme.desc: Vi möter Maria som efter 11 bröstoperationer fått vad hon själv kallar världens fulaste bröst.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 807
programme.desc: 2010 åkte Tina till Thailand för att få sina bröstimplantat utbytta, men operationen gick inte som förväntat och idag har hon smärta som hindrar henne från att dansa.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 302
programme.desc: Två av Danmarks bästa plastikkirurger hjälper människor som råkat ut för misslyckade ingrepp. Vi möter Isabella, en 18-åring vars bröstförstoring blev en total katastrof.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 803
programme.desc: Natasha är en före detta modell. År 2013 fick hon implantaten i sina silikonbröst utbytta, men operationen gick inte som planerat och därför har hon nu två mycket olika bröst.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 806
programme.desc: Tinas mardröm började 2015 när hon fick en tumör på näsan som fortsatte att växa. Hon måste genomgå strålbehandling för att få bort den, men tumören lämnar också ett hål som måste stängas.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 303
programme.desc: Vi möter Doris som har varit med om en våldsam busskrasch. Idag kämpar hon med extrema konsekvenser av den plastikoperation som skulle rädda hennes utseende efter olyckan.
